analysis.reasonEn: Current price $117.92 is at 42.2% of its 52-week low of $88.15 and is trading -12.26% below the SMA200. RSI remains in oversold territory at 38.2, and the MACD histogram continues to worsen at -1.9695. While ADX at 27.9 indicates a clear trend, the -DI (38.4) is higher than the +DI (13.7), suggesting downward pressure is dominant. The price is approaching the weekly SMA100 support at $111.28, offering potential support on further declines. However, the persistent bearish pattern on the daily chart warrants a wait-and-see approach.
